name: Bright LED Electronics Corp.
summary: Bright LED Electronics Corp. operates as a global supplier, specializing in the production and distribution of light-emitting diodes (LEDs), indicator lights, displays, and various other related products. With a broad international presence, the company serves markets across China, Taiwan, Korea, the United States, and beyond. Its comprehensive product range includes sophisticated Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) solutions, such as integrated modules for motors, sensors, and LED light bars. They also offer a diverse selection of LED components, encompassing traditional lamps, advanced displays, surface-mount devices (SMDs), PLCC packages, and infrared emitters. Furthermore, Bright LED manufactures a full spectrum of LED lighting products designed for indoor, outdoor, and specialized applications. Beyond its core manufacturing, the company is involved in the fabrication and refinement of LED dies and artificial crystals. It also conducts extensive import and export activities and provides Printed Circuit Board (PCB) processing services. Bright LED's offerings are utilized as critical components across a multitude of industries, including the 3C (Computer, Communications, and Consumer Electronics) sector, the general lighting market, the automotive industry, and various other specialized applications. The company was founded in 1981 and maintains its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
